blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Alona party-list Rep. Ma. Cristina Talavera-Lopez and 4K party-list Iris Montes on Wednesday aired different perspectives on the proposed inclusion of the Commission on Human Rights (CHR) as a member of the Dangerous Drugs Board (DDB). During the House sponsorship and plenary deliberations on the proposed budget of the DDB for next year, Montes said that the CHR shall be a sitting member of the DDB, noting that the commission can help in formulating policies for anti-drug strategies. The DDB is the policy-making and strategy-formulating body for drug prevention and control. READ: Marcos to issue executive order formalizing […]...
